:::{#def-halting-problem}
#### The halting problem

The **halting problem** HALT is the [decision problem](p-and-np.qmd#def-decision-problem)

$$\text{HALT} \eqdef \set{\angb{w, x} : M_w \text{ halts on input } x},$$

where $\angb{w, x}$ is the [pair encoding](models-of-computation.qmd#def-pair-encoding) of $w$ and $x$,
and $M_w$ is the machine that $w$ [describes](models-of-computation.qmd#def-tm-description)
[@arora2009computational, section 1.5].

:::
